Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Suppose my vampire is in combat. The opponent plays Immortal Grapple (or any other discipline card).
I have 1 Botched Move and 1 Direct Intervention in my hand.

Can I play Botched Move, wait for it to resolve, and, if it doesn't cancel the discipline card, play Direct Intervention after that?

It seems to be allowed by [LSJ 20100710] (http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/a43954e0e0511005), unless the sequencing rule doesn't apply to the "as played" window.

I guess that, if I can, I don't replace my Botched Move (which give me headaches regarding the Victor question (http://boardgamegeek.com/thread/644398/victor-donaldsons-ability)(*)) before playing the DI.

Thanks,
Pascal

((*):  just thought of that: canceled cards might be moved to the ash heap as they are canceled, whereas regular cards would be moved to the ash heap after their resolution..)

~~

Botched Move
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable as the opposing minion plays a card that requires a Discipline.
The opposing minion's controller reveals the top two cards of his or her library (before drawing to replace). If another copy of the same combat card is revealed, the played card is canceled (cost is still paid), the opposing minion takes 1 unpreventable damage, and all revealed copies are burned. A minion may play only one Botched Move each combat.

Direct Intervention
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel a minion card as it is played. No cost is paid. (If it was an action card, the acting minion doesn't tap. If it was a strike card, the minion chooses another strike.)

Messages.Author: hskrfn822
Messages.Body: I'm pretty sure you have the opportunity to play anything you can to try and cancel the card before it resolves, including taking a second crack at it with a different card.  Obviously, this is subject to a card's text taking precedence over the rules of the game, but no particular card comes to mind that fits that description.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
The linked article answers your question explicitly.

?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
In that link, I asked about when do players get their first opportunity to play a card-canceler, given that there hasn't been any played so far.

I am now considering the case when one card canceler (Botched Move) has been played and resolved, and am wondering whether (and in which order) players get the possibility to play a second card-canceler.

One other thing that could also matter is whether I replace the Botched Move before getting the opportunity to play Direct Intervention.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body: Standard sequencing rules apply. Things that are played in the same window can be ordered however the player likes.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
OK, let me check I got that completely:

a/ opponent plays Immortal Grapple, announces level used.
b/ As IG is played, I play Botched Move, which no-one cancels.
c/ Botched Move resolves, and doesn't cancel IG.
d/ I replace Botched Move.
e/ I play Direct Intervention, which no-one cancels.
f/ Direct Intervention is paid and resolves - IG is now "canceled".
h/ Replace Immortal Grapple and Direct Intervention (simultaneously).

Do you confirm that Botched Move is replaced in d/ and not in h/ ?
I'm also not sure when these cards (IG, BM, DI) enter the ash heap. Is it before h/, after h/, in window h/ (matters for this Donaldson thing) ?

Thanks,
Pascal

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
No cards are replaced in the "as played" window.

Messages.Body:
http://boardgamegeek.com/thread/644398/victor-donaldsons-abi... (http://boardgamegeek.com/thread/644398/victor-donaldsons-ability)

Is it
a/ Play Golconda
b/ Golconda gets canceled
c/ Replace Golconda
d/ Activate Victor's ability

or is it
a/ Play Golconda
b/ Golconda gets canceled
c/ Activate Victor's ability
d/ Replace Golconda

or is it
a/ Play Golconda
b/ Golconda gets canceled
c/ Activate Victor's ability, replace golconda (same window)

?

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body: The first one. Draw to replace before using Donaldson's ability (or any other non-as-played effect).
